node.statement: Every W_{gamma,sigma} is unitary, so ||W_{gamma,sigma}||=||W_{gamma,sigma}^dagger||=1; since the nonnegative q's sum to 1, the displayed representation cost is sum q||W^dagger||||W||=sum q=1, and the infimum formula in GT-kitaev-projective-tensor-norm yields ||D||_pi<=1.
